render_execution_device: physical Panther Lake NPU on Delta
findings: The 19 receipts include one frame before sole-indirect confirmation and 18 after. Producer sequence 21 is not the number of delivered frames.

A complete desktop and Run dialog are visible in received NPU-path frames. The earliest preserved Run frame arrives 141.629111 seconds after Win+R. A later frame was used to release the manual input gate; that reviewer delay is retained separately.
Notepad is launched but its complete UI, typing, maximize and close are not verified on the NPU path. The complete UI screenshot is only from the ordinary display after guest driver removal.

The worker and observer were extended, but the independently hardcoded relay lifetime was overlooked. Its log stops at the ten-minute boundary. The worker reports socket closed or timed out; no device-loss or queue-creation failure is logged. The first complete failed DWM capture is recorded about one second after relay expiry.
All 830 successful NPU worker requests have matching positive guest acknowledgements. Zero negative acknowledgements does not mean the desktop passed: later UMD calls fail after transport closure.

The topology task ends with 267014 (0x41306), without a restoration or final result record. The exact point of termination is unknown. The observer waits its 1530-second bound, then successfully removes both owned guest devices. A complete ordinary desktop is visually verified afterward; no reboot occurs.

All 120 raw archive members are verified against the guest SHA256 manifest on Delta. The 450632239-byte archive is retained there; a 108384-byte text-only archive is downloaded and each included member is independently checked on the Mac.
Full desktop offload, practical interaction, physical display migration and a Tahoma benefit remain unfinished.
